newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen steady.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen steady.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.03 up at 40.17 to the dollar in the kerb market on Sunday amid a rise in supply of the U.S. currency, dealers said.
They said the rupee was likely to remain steady around current levels as there was enough demand for dollar to absorb higher supply.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on September 10, was 36.9700/37.1549 rupees to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed unchanged at 8.55 percent. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
